## Specification

### Component: Calendar

A month grid for picking one date, several dates or a range. Plain `Date` objects at local midnight; date maths lives in exported helpers (`date-utils.ts`) so a date picker can reuse it inside a popover.

#### Anatomy
```
<Calendar>                         div.ui-calendar (data-mode)
  div.ui-calendar-months           flex, wraps, gap 20px / 32px
    div.ui-calendar-month          one per numberOfMonths
      div.ui-calendar-caption      prev button (first month) · title · next button (last month)
        button.ui-calendar-nav     32px square, chevron icon, aria-label "Previous month" / "Next month"
        div.ui-calendar-title      "November 2026", aria-live="polite"
      table.ui-calendar-grid       role="grid", aria-labelledby = title id
        thead th.ui-calendar-weekday  (scope=col, abbr = full weekday)
        tbody tr td.ui-calendar-cell (role=gridcell, aria-selected) > button.ui-calendar-day
```
Always 6 week rows so the height never jumps.

#### Props
- `mode`: `single` (default) | `multiple` | `range`. `value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange` — `Date | null`, `Date[]`, `{ from: Date | null; to: Date | null }`.
- `month` / `defaultMonth` / `onMonthChange`, `numberOfMonths` (1), `weekStartsOn` (1 = Monday), `locale` (`en-US`), `min`, `max`, `disabled` (`Date[]` or `(d) => boolean`), `showOutsideDays` (true; single month only), `today`, `previousLabel`, `nextLabel`.
- Helpers exported: `startOfDay addDays addMonths addYears startOfMonth endOfMonth startOfWeek endOfWeek isSameDay isSameMonth isBefore isAfter isBetween compareDays clampDate getMonthWeeks getWeekdayLabels dateKey monthKey parseDateKey matchesDate formatMonthYear formatFullDate`, and `nextRange toggleDate orderDates`.

#### Behaviour
- Weekday names and month title come from `Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale)`.
- `single`: a click selects (stays selected). `multiple`: click toggles. `range`: 1st click = start, 2nd = end (either direction, ordered), 3rd starts over.
- Range preview: while only the start is set, hovering a day (mouse) or moving keyboard focus shows the band to that day in a lighter tint; the preview end gets a 1px ring.
- Disabled dates (`min`/`max`/`disabled`) get `aria-disabled` and stay focusable; they cannot be selected. Prev/next use `aria-disabled` at the min/max month edge.
- Outside days are muted buttons; clicking one selects it and turns to that month. With `numberOfMonths > 1` they are hidden.
- Month change: grid and title are remounted with a slide + fade; no animation on first render.
- One tab stop (roving tabindex): selected day, else today, else the 1st of the month.

#### Visual rules
- Cell 36px (44px on `pointer: coarse`); day button fills the cell, radius `--radius-md`; 14px, tabular numbers. Weekday row 12px/500 `--ui-muted-foreground`. Title 14px/600.
- Selected: `--ui-primary` fill, `--ui-primary-foreground` text. Today: 1px inset `--ui-border-strong` outline + weight 600 (no fill). Outside: muted. Disabled: muted, opacity .45, line-through.
- Range band: on the cell (td) so it is continuous: `color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 12%, transparent)`; start/end cells carry a half band (gradient) behind the selected cap; band edges round at week boundaries. Preview band 7%.
- Hover (fine pointer only): `--ui-accent`. Focus: ring `0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent)`.

#### Motion
- Month change: `ui-cal-in-next|prev` 220ms `--ui-ease-out`, translateX(±10px) + opacity 0 → 1. Press scales to .94 on `--ui-spring-snappy`. Reduced motion: no slide.

#### Accessibility
- WAI-ARIA date grid. Each day button `aria-label` = full date (`dateStyle: full`), today `aria-current="date"`, selected td `aria-selected="true"`.
- Keys: arrows ±1 day / ±1 week; Home/End first/last day of the week; PageUp/PageDown ±1 month (day clamped); Shift+PageUp/PageDown ±1 year; Enter/Space select. Moving past a visible month changes month and keeps focus.

#### Acceptance checks
- Arrow keys cross month edges and focus follows; Page keys change month and year.
- Range shows a continuous tinted band with capped ends and a hover preview; min/max/disabled days cannot be selected.
- Two months sit side by side on desktop and stack on a 390px screen without horizontal scroll.
- No axe violations in light and dark.

### `ui/components/calendar/calendar-grid.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { memo, useMemo, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import { dateKey, getMonthWeeks, getWeekdayLabels, isSameDay, isSameMonth, type WeekStart } from './date-utils';

/** What a day cell needs to know about the selection. */
export interface DayState {
  /** A date the user actually picked. */
  selected: boolean;
  /** Position inside the (possibly previewed) range band. */
  range?: 'start' | 'middle' | 'end';
  /** The band is a hover/keyboard preview, not a committed range. */
  preview?: boolean;
}

export interface CalendarGridProps {
  month: Date;
  titleId: string;
  weekStartsOn: WeekStart;
  locale?: string;
  /** Show the days of the neighbouring months (single-month calendars only). */
  showOutsideDays: boolean;
  /** The one day that is in the tab order. */
  tabDate: Date;
  today: Date | null;
  isDisabled: (d: Date) => boolean;
  getState: (d: Date) => DayState;
  onSelect: (d: Date) => void;
  onPreview: (d: Date | null) => void;
  onKeyDown: (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => void;
  /** Slide direction after a month change; null on first render. */
  direction: 'next' | 'prev' | null;
}

/** One month as an ARIA grid (a real table with role="grid"). */
export const CalendarGrid = memo(function CalendarGrid({
  month,
  titleId,
  weekStartsOn,
  locale,
  showOutsideDays,
  tabDate,
  today,
  isDisabled,
  getState,
  onSelect,
  onPreview,
  onKeyDown,
  direction,
}: CalendarGridProps) {
  const weekdays = useMemo(() => getWeekdayLabels(locale, weekStartsOn), [locale, weekStartsOn]);
  const weeks = useMemo(() => getMonthWeeks(month, weekStartsOn), [month, weekStartsOn]);
  const fullFormat = useMemo(() => new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { dateStyle: 'full' }), [locale]);

  return (
    <table role="grid" className="ui-calendar-grid" aria-labelledby={titleId} data-direction={direction ?? undefined} onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          {weekdays.map((w) => (
            <th key={w.long} scope="col" abbr={w.long} className="ui-calendar-weekday">
              {w.short}
            </th>
          ))}
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {weeks.map((week) => (
          <tr key={dateKey(week[0]!)}>
            {week.map((date) => {
              const outside = !isSameMonth(date, month);
              if (outside && !showOutsideDays) {
                return <td key={dateKey(date)} role="gridcell" aria-hidden="true" className="ui-calendar-cell" />;
              }
              const state = getState(date);
              const disabled = isDisabled(date);
              const isToday = today !== null && isSameDay(date, today);
              const tabbable = !outside && isSameDay(date, tabDate);
              return (
                <td
                  key={dateKey(date)}
                  role="gridcell"
                  className="ui-calendar-cell"
                  aria-selected={state.selected || undefined}
                  data-range={state.range}
                  data-preview={state.preview || undefined}
                >
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="ui-calendar-day"
                    data-date={dateKey(date)}
                    data-selected={state.selected || undefined}
                    data-range-edge={state.range && state.range !== 'middle' ? state.range : undefined}
                    data-today={isToday || undefined}
                    data-outside={outside || undefined}
                    data-disabled={disabled || undefined}
                    aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
                    aria-current={isToday ? 'date' : undefined}
                    aria-label={fullFormat.format(date)}
                    tabIndex={tabbable ? 0 : -1}
                    onClick={() => onSelect(date)}
                    onPointerEnter={(e) => e.pointerType === 'mouse' && onPreview(date)}
                  >
                    {date.getDate()}
                  </button>
                </td>
              );
            })}
          </tr>
        ))}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/calendar/calendar.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
} from 'react';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { composeRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { CalendarGrid, type DayState } from './calendar-grid';
import {
  addDays,
  addMonths,
  addYears,
  clampDate,
  compareDays,
  endOfMonth,
  endOfWeek,
  formatMonthYear,
  isAfter,
  isBefore,
  isBetween,
  isSameDay,
  isSameMonth,
  matchesDate,
  monthKey,
  parseDateKey,
  startOfDay,
  startOfMonth,
  startOfWeek,
  type DateMatcher,
  type WeekStart,
} from './date-utils';
import {
  emptyRange,
  firstSelectedDate,
  nextRange,
  orderDates,
  toggleDate,
  type CalendarSelection,
  type DateRange,
} from './selection';

export type CalendarMode = 'single' | 'multiple' | 'range';

interface CalendarBaseProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange'> {
  /** Month shown (controlled). Any day in the month works. */
  month?: Date;
  /** Month shown first (uncontrolled). Default: the selected date, else today. */
  defaultMonth?: Date;
  onMonthChange?: (month: Date) => void;
  /** Months side by side (they wrap on narrow screens). Default 1. */
  numberOfMonths?: number;
  /** First column: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Default 1 (Monday). */
  weekStartsOn?: WeekStart;
  /** BCP 47 tag for month and weekday names. Default `en-US`. */
  locale?: string;
  /** Earliest selectable date. */
  min?: Date;
  /** Latest selectable date. */
  max?: Date;
  /** Dates that cannot be picked: a list, or a function returning true to disable. */
  disabled?: DateMatcher;
  /** Show the grey days of neighbouring months (single month only). Default true. */
  showOutsideDays?: boolean;
  /** Treat this as "today" (tests, demos). Default: the current date. */
  today?: Date;
  /** Accessible names for the month buttons. */
  previousLabel?: string;
  nextLabel?: string;
}

export interface CalendarSingleProps extends CalendarBaseProps {
  mode?: 'single';
  value?: Date | null;
  defaultValue?: Date | null;
  onValueChange?: (value: Date | null) => void;
}
export interface CalendarMultipleProps extends CalendarBaseProps {
  mode: 'multiple';
  value?: Date[];
  defaultValue?: Date[];
  onValueChange?: (value: Date[]) => void;
}
export interface CalendarRangeProps extends CalendarBaseProps {
  mode: 'range';
  value?: DateRange;
  defaultValue?: DateRange;
  onValueChange?: (value: DateRange) => void;
}
export type CalendarProps = CalendarSingleProps | CalendarMultipleProps | CalendarRangeProps;

type LooseProps = CalendarBaseProps & {
  mode?: CalendarMode;
  value?: CalendarSelection;
  defaultValue?: CalendarSelection;
  onValueChange?: (value: CalendarSelection) => void;
};

/**
 * Calendar — month grid with single, multiple and range selection, min/max/
 * disabled dates, several months side by side and the APG date-grid keyboard map.
 * Dates are plain `Date` objects at local midnight.
 */
export const Calendar = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, CalendarProps>(function Calendar(props, ref) {
  const {
    mode = 'single',
    value,
    defaultValue,
    onValueChange,
    month: monthProp,
    defaultMonth,
    onMonthChange,
    numberOfMonths = 1,
    weekStartsOn = 1,
    locale = 'en-US',
    min,
    max,
    disabled,
    showOutsideDays = true,
    today: todayProp,
    previousLabel = 'Previous month',
    nextLabel = 'Next month',
    className,
    onFocus,
    onBlur,
    onPointerLeave,
    ...rest
  } = props as LooseProps;

  const count = Math.max(1, Math.floor(numberOfMonths));
  const baseId = useId();
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const [nowState] = useState(() => new Date());
  const today = useMemo(() => startOfDay(todayProp ?? nowState), [todayProp, nowState]);

  const [selection, setSelection] = useControllableState<CalendarSelection>({
    value,
    defaultValue: defaultValue ?? (mode === 'multiple' ? [] : mode === 'range' ? emptyRange() : null),
    onChange: onValueChange,
  });

  const [firstMonth, setFirstMonth] = useControllableState<Date>({
    value: monthProp ? startOfMonth(monthProp) : undefined,
    defaultValue: startOfMonth(defaultMonth ?? firstSelectedDate(selection) ?? today),
    onChange: onMonthChange,
  });
  const lastMonth = addMonths(firstMonth, count - 1);

  const isVisible = useCallback(
    (d: Date) => compareDays(d, firstMonth) >= 0 && compareDays(d, endOfMonth(lastMonth)) <= 0,
    [firstMonth, lastMonth],
  );

  const [focusDate, setFocusDate] = useState<Date>(() => {
    const picked = firstSelectedDate(selection);
    const start = startOfMonth(defaultMonth ?? picked ?? today);
    const end = endOfMonth(addMonths(start, count - 1));
    if (picked && isBetween(picked, start, end)) return picked;
    return isBetween(today, start, end) ? today : start;
  });
  const [direction, setDirection] = useState<'next' | 'prev' | null>(null);
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<Date | null>(null);
  const [inside, setInside] = useState(false);
  const focusRequest = useRef(false);

  const isDisabled = useCallback(
    (d: Date) => (min && isBefore(d, min)) || (max && isAfter(d, max)) || matchesDate(d, disabled) || false,
    [min, max, disabled],
  );

  const goToMonth = useCallback(
    (target: Date) => {
      const next = startOfMonth(target);
      if (isSameMonth(next, firstMonth)) return;
      setDirection(isAfter(next, firstMonth) ? 'next' : 'prev');
      setFirstMonth(next);
      // Keep the tab stop inside the new view (same day of month, clamped)
      setFocusDate((prev) => {
        const end = endOfMonth(addMonths(next, count - 1));
        if (isBetween(prev, next, end)) return prev;
        const dim = endOfMonth(next).getDate();
        return new Date(next.getFullYear(), next.getMonth(), Math.min(prev.getDate(), dim));
      });
    },
    [firstMonth, setFirstMonth, count],
  );

  const moveFocus = useCallback(
    (to: Date) => {
      const target = clampDate(to, min, max);
      focusRequest.current = true;
      setFocusDate(target);
      if (!isVisible(target)) {
        goToMonth(isBefore(target, firstMonth) ? target : addMonths(target, -(count - 1)));
      }
    },
    [min, max, isVisible, goToMonth, firstMonth, count],
  );

  // After a keyboard move, focus the button once it has rendered (the month may have changed)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!focusRequest.current) return;
    focusRequest.current = false;
    rootRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.ui-calendar-day[tabindex="0"]')?.focus();
  }, [focusDate, firstMonth]);

  const handleSelect = useCallback(
    (d: Date) => {
      if (isDisabled(d)) return;
      // A grey day of a neighbouring month: select it and turn to its month
      if (!isVisible(d) || (count === 1 && !isSameMonth(d, firstMonth))) goToMonth(d);
      setFocusDate(d);
      if (mode === 'multiple') setSelection(toggleDate((selection as Date[]) ?? [], d));
      else if (mode === 'range') setSelection(nextRange((selection as DateRange) ?? emptyRange(), d));
      else setSelection(d);
    },
    [isDisabled, isVisible, count, firstMonth, goToMonth, mode, selection, setSelection],
  );

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    const from = parseDateKey((e.target as HTMLElement).dataset?.date);
    if (!from || e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;
    let next: Date;
    switch (e.key) {
      case 'ArrowLeft': next = addDays(from, -1); break;
      case 'ArrowRight': next = addDays(from, 1); break;
      case 'ArrowUp': next = addDays(from, -7); break;
      case 'ArrowDown': next = addDays(from, 7); break;
      case 'Home': next = startOfWeek(from, weekStartsOn); break;
      case 'End': next = endOfWeek(from, weekStartsOn); break;
      case 'PageUp': next = e.shiftKey ? addYears(from, -1) : addMonths(from, -1); break;
      case 'PageDown': next = e.shiftKey ? addYears(from, 1) : addMonths(from, 1); break;
      default: return;
    }
    e.preventDefault();
    moveFocus(next);
  };

  // Range band: committed, or previewed while the end is still open
  const range = mode === 'range' ? ((selection as DateRange | null) ?? emptyRange()) : null;
  const previewTarget = hover ?? (inside ? focusDate : null);
  const previewing = !!range?.from && !range.to && !!previewTarget && !isSameDay(range.from, previewTarget);
  const band: [Date, Date] | null =
    range?.from && range.to
      ? [range.from, range.to]
      : previewing && range?.from && previewTarget
        ? orderDates(range.from, previewTarget)
        : null;

  const getState = (d: Date): DayState => {
    if (mode === 'multiple') return { selected: ((selection as Date[]) ?? []).some((x) => isSameDay(x, d)) };
    if (mode === 'single') return { selected: !!selection && isSameDay(selection as Date, d) };
    const selected = !!range && ((!!range.from && isSameDay(range.from, d)) || (!!range.to && isSameDay(range.to, d)));
    if (!band || isSameDay(band[0], band[1])) return { selected };
    const pos = isSameDay(d, band[0]) ? 'start' : isSameDay(d, band[1]) ? 'end' : isBetween(d, band[0], band[1]) ? 'middle' : undefined;
    return { selected, range: pos, preview: pos && !range?.to ? true : undefined };
  };

  const tabDate = isVisible(focusDate) ? focusDate : clampDate(firstMonth, min, max);
  const canPrev = !min || !isBefore(endOfMonth(addMonths(firstMonth, -1)), min);
  const canNext = !max || !isAfter(startOfMonth(addMonths(lastMonth, 1)), max);
  const onPreview = (d: Date | null) => {
    if (range?.from && !range.to) setHover(d);
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={composeRefs(ref, rootRef)}
      className={cn('ui-calendar', className)}
      data-mode={mode}
      onFocus={(e) => {
        setInside(true);
        onFocus?.(e);
      }}
      onBlur={(e) => {
        if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) setInside(false);
        onBlur?.(e);
      }}
      onPointerLeave={(e) => {
        setHover(null);
        onPointerLeave?.(e);
      }}
      {...rest}
    >
      <div className="ui-calendar-months">
        {Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
          const m = addMonths(firstMonth, i);
          const titleId = `${baseId}-title-${i}`;
          return (
            <div key={i} className="ui-calendar-month">
              <div className="ui-calendar-caption">
                {i === 0 ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="ui-calendar-nav"
                    aria-label={previousLabel}
                    aria-disabled={!canPrev || undefined}
                    onClick={() => canPrev && goToMonth(addMonths(firstMonth, -1))}
                  >
                    <Icon name="chevron-left" />
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <span className="ui-calendar-nav-spacer" />
                )}
                <div key={monthKey(m)} id={titleId} className="ui-calendar-title" aria-live="polite" data-direction={direction ?? undefined}>
                  {formatMonthYear(m, locale)}
                </div>
                {i === count - 1 ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="ui-calendar-nav"
                    aria-label={nextLabel}
                    aria-disabled={!canNext || undefined}
                    onClick={() => canNext && goToMonth(addMonths(firstMonth, 1))}
                  >
                    <Icon name="chevron-right" />
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <span className="ui-calendar-nav-spacer" />
                )}
              </div>
              <CalendarGrid
                key={monthKey(m)}
                month={m}
                titleId={titleId}
                weekStartsOn={weekStartsOn}
                locale={locale}
                showOutsideDays={showOutsideDays && count === 1}
                tabDate={tabDate}
                today={today}
                isDisabled={isDisabled}
                getState={getState}
                onSelect={handleSelect}
                onPreview={onPreview}
                onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
                direction={direction}
              />
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/calendar/date-utils.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Date helpers for Calendar (and the Phase 2 date picker).
 * Plain `Date` objects, always at local midnight, so DST and time zones never
 * shift a day: every function builds dates from (year, month, day) parts.
 */

/** 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. */
export type WeekStart = 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;

/** A list of dates, or a predicate, used to disable days. */
export type DateMatcher = Date[] | ((date: Date) => boolean);

export const startOfDay = (d: Date): Date => new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate());

export const addDays = (d: Date, n: number): Date => new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate() + n);

export const getDaysInMonth = (d: Date): number => new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate();

export const startOfMonth = (d: Date): Date => new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), 1);

export const endOfMonth = (d: Date): Date => new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth() + 1, 0);

/** Add months, clamping the day (31 Jan + 1 month = 28/29 Feb). */
export function addMonths(d: Date, n: number): Date {
  const first = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth() + n, 1);
  return new Date(first.getFullYear(), first.getMonth(), Math.min(d.getDate(), getDaysInMonth(first)));
}

export const addYears = (d: Date, n: number): Date => addMonths(d, n * 12);

export const isSameDay = (a: Date, b: Date): boolean =>
  a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() && a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() && a.getDate() === b.getDate();

export const isSameMonth = (a: Date, b: Date): boolean =>
  a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() && a.getMonth() === b.getMonth();

/** Compare by calendar day: negative when a is before b, 0 when the same day. */
export const compareDays = (a: Date, b: Date): number =>
  a.getFullYear() - b.getFullYear() || a.getMonth() - b.getMonth() || a.getDate() - b.getDate();

export const isBefore = (a: Date, b: Date): boolean => compareDays(a, b) < 0;
export const isAfter = (a: Date, b: Date): boolean => compareDays(a, b) > 0;

/** Inclusive; `a` and `b` may be given in either order. */
export function isBetween(d: Date, a: Date, b: Date): boolean {
  const [from, to] = compareDays(a, b) <= 0 ? [a, b] : [b, a];
  return compareDays(d, from) >= 0 && compareDays(d, to) <= 0;
}

export function startOfWeek(d: Date, weekStartsOn: WeekStart = 1): Date {
  return addDays(d, -((d.getDay() - weekStartsOn + 7) % 7));
}

export function endOfWeek(d: Date, weekStartsOn: WeekStart = 1): Date {
  return addDays(startOfWeek(d, weekStartsOn), 6);
}

/** Pull `d` into [min, max] (either may be omitted). */
export function clampDate(d: Date, min?: Date | null, max?: Date | null): Date {
  if (min && isBefore(d, min)) return startOfDay(min);
  if (max && isAfter(d, max)) return startOfDay(max);
  return d;
}

/** The weeks shown for a month: Date[7][] — 6 rows by default so the height never jumps. */
export function getMonthWeeks(month: Date, weekStartsOn: WeekStart = 1, fixedWeeks = true): Date[][] {
  const first = startOfWeek(startOfMonth(month), weekStartsOn);
  const last = endOfWeek(endOfMonth(month), weekStartsOn);
  const rows = fixedWeeks ? 6 : Math.round((last.getTime() - first.getTime()) / 604_800_000);
  const weeks: Date[][] = [];
  for (let w = 0; w < rows; w++) {
    weeks.push(Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => addDays(first, w * 7 + i)));
  }
  return weeks;
}

const pad = (n: number, len = 2) => String(n).padStart(len, '0');

/** 'YYYY-MM-DD' in local time — a stable key, never `toISOString()` (that is UTC). */
export const dateKey = (d: Date): string => `${pad(d.getFullYear(), 4)}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`;

export const monthKey = (d: Date): string => `${pad(d.getFullYear(), 4)}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}`;

/** Inverse of dateKey. Returns null for anything that is not a real date. */
export function parseDateKey(key: string | undefined | null): Date | null {
  const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(key ?? '');
  if (!m) return null;
  const [y, mo, da] = [Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]), Number(m[3])];
  const d = new Date(y, mo - 1, da);
  return d.getFullYear() === y && d.getMonth() === mo - 1 && d.getDate() === da ? d : null;
}

/** True when `d` matches a disabled-dates list or predicate. */
export function matchesDate(d: Date, matcher?: DateMatcher): boolean {
  if (!matcher) return false;
  return typeof matcher === 'function' ? matcher(d) : matcher.some((m) => isSameDay(m, d));
}

export interface WeekdayLabel {
  /** 'Monday' */
  long: string;
  /** 'Mon' */
  short: string;
}

/** Weekday names from Intl, starting at `weekStartsOn`. */
export function getWeekdayLabels(locale: string | undefined, weekStartsOn: WeekStart = 1): WeekdayLabel[] {
  const long = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { weekday: 'long' });
  const short = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { weekday: 'short' });
  // 1 Jan 2023 was a Sunday
  return Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => {
    const d = new Date(2023, 0, 1 + ((weekStartsOn + i) % 7));
    return { long: long.format(d), short: short.format(d) };
  });
}

export const formatMonthYear = (d: Date, locale?: string): string =>
  new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }).format(d);

export const formatFullDate = (d: Date, locale?: string): string =>
  new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { dateStyle: 'full' }).format(d);
```

### `ui/components/calendar/selection.ts`

```ts
import { compareDays, isSameDay } from './date-utils';

/** A date range. `to` is null while the user has only picked the start. */
export interface DateRange {
  from: Date | null;
  to: Date | null;
}

export type CalendarSelection = Date | null | Date[] | DateRange;

export const emptyRange = (): DateRange => ({ from: null, to: null });

/** Order two dates so the earlier one comes first. */
export function orderDates(a: Date, b: Date): [Date, Date] {
  return compareDays(a, b) <= 0 ? [a, b] : [b, a];
}

/** Add `d` to the list, or remove it when it is already there. */
export function toggleDate(list: Date[], d: Date): Date[] {
  return list.some((x) => isSameDay(x, d)) ? list.filter((x) => !isSameDay(x, d)) : [...list, d];
}

/**
 * The range after the user picks `d`:
 * 1st pick sets the start, 2nd completes it (either direction), a 3rd starts over.
 */
export function nextRange(range: DateRange, d: Date): DateRange {
  if (range.from && !range.to) {
    const [from, to] = orderDates(range.from, d);
    return { from, to };
  }
  return { from: d, to: null };
}

/** First selected date of any selection shape (used to pick the initial month). */
export function firstSelectedDate(sel: CalendarSelection | undefined): Date | null {
  if (!sel) return null;
  if (sel instanceof Date) return sel;
  if (Array.isArray(sel)) return sel[0] ?? null;
  return sel.from;
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/calendar.css`

```css
/* Calendar ----------------------------------------------------------------
   .ui-calendar > .ui-calendar-months > .ui-calendar-month
     .ui-calendar-caption: .ui-calendar-nav (prev) · .ui-calendar-title · .ui-calendar-nav (next)
     table.ui-calendar-grid[role=grid] > th.ui-calendar-weekday, td.ui-calendar-cell > button.ui-calendar-day
   Day state: [data-selected] [data-today] [data-outside] [data-disabled] [data-range-edge]
   Cell (td) state: [data-range="start|middle|end"] [data-preview]
   Size: --ui-cal-cell (36px, 44px on touch screens)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-calendar {
    --ui-cal-cell: 2.25rem;
    --ui-cal-band: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 12%, transparent);
    display: inline-block;
    max-width: 100%;
    padding: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
  }
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    .ui-calendar { --ui-cal-cell: 2.75rem; }
  }
  .ui-calendar-months { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1.25rem 2rem; }
  .ui-calendar-month { min-width: 0; }

  /* Caption */
  .ui-calendar-caption {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    height: 2rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }
  .ui-calendar-title {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .ui-calendar-nav,
  .ui-calendar-nav-spacer { flex-shrink: 0; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; }
  .ui-calendar-nav {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border-strong);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background-color: var(--ui-background);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-xs);
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-calendar-nav:active:not([aria-disabled="true"]) { transform: scale(0.94); }
  .ui-calendar-nav:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  .ui-calendar-nav[aria-disabled="true"] { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-calendar-nav:hover:not([aria-disabled="true"]) { background-color: var(--ui-accent); }
  }
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    .ui-calendar-nav, .ui-calendar-nav-spacer { width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; }
    .ui-calendar-caption { height: 2.75rem; }
  }

  /* Grid */
  .ui-calendar-grid { border-collapse: collapse; border-spacing: 0; table-layout: fixed; }
  .ui-calendar-weekday {
    width: var(--ui-cal-cell);
    height: 2rem;
    padding: 0;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    font-weight: 500;
    text-align: center;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .ui-calendar-cell {
    width: var(--ui-cal-cell);
    height: var(--ui-cal-cell);
    padding: 0;
    text-align: center;
  }

  /* Range band: the cell carries the tint so it runs unbroken from cap to cap */
  .ui-calendar-cell[data-range="middle"] { background-color: var(--ui-cal-band); }
  .ui-calendar-cell[data-range="start"] { background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent 50%, var(--ui-cal-band) 50%); }
  .ui-calendar-cell[data-range="end"] { background: linear-gradient(to left, transparent 50%, var(--ui-cal-band) 50%); }
  .ui-calendar-cell[data-range="middle"]:first-child { border-radius: var(--radius-md) 0 0 var(--radius-md); }
  .ui-calendar-cell[data-range="middle"]:last-child { border-radius: 0 var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0; }
  .ui-calendar-cell[data-range="start"]:last-child,
  .ui-calendar-cell[data-range="end"]:first-child { background: none; }
  .ui-calendar-cell[data-preview][data-range="middle"] { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 7%, transparent); }
  .ui-calendar-cell[data-preview][data-range="start"] { background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent 50%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 7%, transparent) 50%); }
  .ui-calendar-cell[data-preview][data-range="end"] { background: linear-gradient(to left, transparent 50%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 7%, transparent) 50%); }

  /* Day */
  .ui-calendar-day {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background-color: transparent;
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font: inherit;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-calendar-day:hover:not([data-selected], [data-disabled]) { background-color: var(--ui-accent); }
  }
  .ui-calendar-day:active:not([data-disabled]) { transform: scale(0.94); }
  .ui-calendar-day:focus-visible {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent);
  }

  /* Today: a quiet outline plus weight, never a fill (the fill means "selected") */
  .ui-calendar-day[data-today] { font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ui-border-strong); }
  .ui-calendar-day[data-today]:focus-visible {
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ui-border-strong), 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent);
  }

  .ui-calendar-day[data-outside] { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }
  .ui-calendar-day[data-disabled] { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; }

  /* Selected */
  .ui-calendar-day[data-selected] {
    background-color: var(--ui-primary);
    color: var(--ui-primary-foreground);
    font-weight: 500;
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  .ui-calendar-day[data-selected]:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }

  /* The previewed end of a range that is still open */
  .ui-calendar-cell[data-preview] > .ui-calendar-day[data-range-edge]:not([data-selected]) {
    background-color: var(--ui-cal-band);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 45%, transparent);
  }
  /* Inside a band the day itself stays transparent, the cell shows the tint */
  .ui-calendar-cell[data-range="middle"] > .ui-calendar-day:not([data-selected]) { border-radius: 0; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-calendar-cell[data-range="middle"] > .ui-calendar-day:hover:not([data-disabled]) { border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
  }

  /* Month change: content slides a few px and fades in */
  .ui-calendar-grid[data-direction="next"],
  .ui-calendar-title[data-direction="next"] { animation: ui-cal-in-next var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both; }
  .ui-calendar-grid[data-direction="prev"],
  .ui-calendar-title[data-direction="prev"] { animation: ui-cal-in-prev var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both; }

  @keyframes ui-cal-in-next { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
  @keyframes ui-cal-in-prev { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
}
```

## Usage

**Single date** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/calendar/single.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Calendar } from '@/ui/components/calendar';

const format = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' });

export default function CalendarSingle() {
  const [date, setDate] = useState<Date | null>(null);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card">
        <Calendar value={date} onValueChange={setDate} />
      </div>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground" aria-live="polite">
        {date ? `Demo booked for ${format.format(date)}` : 'Pick a day for your demo'}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```
